## 💡 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of the feature or operational enhancement you are proposing.

---

## 🎯 Problem / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a specific problem or SOC workflow bottleneck? 
*Example: "When analyzing large batches of emails, manually copying outputs takes too long..."*

---

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it should ideally work in the UI or API backend.

---

## 🎨 Design / Mockups (Optional)
If applicable, attach UI mockups, visual wireframes, or API JSON schema proposals.

---

## Alternative Solutions Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

---

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, reference links, or similar implementation examples from other threat intelligence platforms.
